name: Numen (1.16.5 port)
description: LLM-powered AI companions for Minecraft 1.16.5. Summon a companion (a server-side fake player) and talk to it in natural language. The agent runs on the server: either the built-in brain (provider and API key in config/numen.json), or an external agent driving it over the built-in MCP server. Players need no client mod. Unofficial port of https://github.com/Dwinovo/minecraft-numen
